(1) Indigenous Data Sovereignty Treaty (api-docs.native-land.ca/data-sovereignty-treaty): permitted = educational/research aligned with IDS, non-commercial applications that generate no revenue, Indigenous-led initiatives; prohibited = charging for access or integration, commercial use, modifying boundaries without consultation and approval, misrepresenting territories, derivatives that do not acknowledge Indigenous ownership, storing or distributing API data without explicit NLD permission; attribution to NLD and acknowledgement of Indigenous communities required; NLD may revoke access and take legal action. (2) api-docs About-and-disclaimers: "not under any proprietary license; the work can be considered under a CC0 license", yet "not meant or reasonably to use for academic or legal purposes". (3) native-land.ca FAQ: commercial use "No", suggested credit "Used with permission for educational and non-commercial purposes", maps "should not be used for legal claims, land disputes"; site footer "©Native Land Digital 2024, All rights reserved." API key (required since late 2024) requires ticking an agreement box. No document is titled Terms of Use; no way to request permission is stated. Not legal advice.
